basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 14A at Millennium Tower  a desirable corner unit with hardwood floors, newer bedroom carpeting, and custom Brazilian marble countertops. The chef's kitchen features a Sub-Zero fridge and Bosch appliances, opening into a generous main living area with bedrooms on opposite ends for privacy.  Enjoy a private entryway, great natural light, west-facing views down Mission Street, and a peek at Salesforce Park from the second bedroom. Millennium Tower remains one of San Francisco's premier luxury buildings, offering 24-hour concierge and security, valet parking, a state-of-the-art gym, spa, saltwater pool, screening room, wine cellar, resident lounge with full-service bar and dining room, children's playroom, and more. Don't miss this incredible opportunity to experience luxury at its finest! Ideally located in the heart of downtown, just moments from the Ferry Plaza's shops and cafes, iconic Embarcadero Waterfront, with convenient access to Highways 101 and 280.
